Message.Name: Instrument Definition Message
Message.Description: Describes a futures outright prompt date or option call or put strike.

Field.Name: InstrumentID
Field.Description: Unique Instrument Identifier.

Field.Name: Name
Field.Description: Instrument name.

Field.Name: ContractCode
Field.Description: Contract to which the instrument belongs.

Field.Name: UnderlyingInstrumentID
Field.Description: A reference to the underlying Instrument. Null otherwise.

Field.Name: ExpiryDate
Field.Description: Expiry date, as YYYYMMDD.

Field.Name: StrikePrice
Field.Description: Option Exercise Price, in implicit six decimal place format. Null for futures.

Field.Name: OptionType
Field.Description: Call or Put. Space if Contract Type is Future.

Field.Name: CFICode
Field.Description: The instrument classification according to ISO 10962.

Field.Name: ISIN
Field.Description: ISIN Code. Not applicable if the Instrument belongs to an algorithmic test contract.

Message.Name: Tradable Instrument Definition Message
Message.Description: Describes an individual outright, strategy or Trade at Reference tradable instrument on the Ring or Inter Office venue. An option tradable instrument is published only once on the day of creation and is published at the start of day on the next business day.

Field.Name: TradableInstrumentID
Field.Description: Tradable instrument ID.

Field.Name: InstrumentID
Field.Description: The linkage between Tradable Instrument and Instrument. Null if InstrumentType is Strategy.

Field.Name: TradingVenue
Field.Description: Trading venue.

Field.Name: BusinessDaysToExpiry
Field.Description: Numeric indicator of the number of Business Days to Expiry used as a measure of how far the instrument is down the curve. Null if Contract Type is Option.

Field.Name: LastTradingDate
Field.Description: Last Trading Date, as YYYYMMDD.

Field.Name: TickSizeID
Field.Description: Tick Size ID.

Field.Name: ContractCode
Field.Description: A unique code to identify the contract.

Field.Name: ContractType
Field.Description: Constant contract type.

Field.Name: InstrumentType
Field.Description: Instrument Type.

Field.Name: TradingCurrency
Field.Description: The currency code according to ISO 4217.

Field.Name: MarketCode
Field.Description: Market Code.

Field.Name: MarketSegmentCode
Field.Description: A string identifier for the individual market segment to which the tradable instrument belongs.

Field.Name: ProductCode
Field.Description: Product code. This identifies the metal.

Field.Name: UnderlyingTradableInstrumentID
Field.Description: Underlying Tradable Instrument ID. Null when no underlying Tradable Instrument exists or the Tradable Instrument is a strategy.

Field.Name: SettlementDate
Field.Description: Settlement Date, as YYYYMMDD. Null for a rolling prompt or strategy.

Field.Name: ExpiryDate
Field.Description: The expiry date for this tradable instrument, as YYYYMMDD. Null for a strategy.

Field.Name: OptionType
Field.Description: For option tradable instruments, whether this tradable instrument represents a call or a put option. Not applicable for a future or strategy.

Field.Name: StrikePrice
Field.Description: The strike price for this tradable instrument, in implicit six decimal place format. Null for a future or strategy.

Field.Name: CFICode
Field.Description: The instrument classification according to ISO 10962. Not applicable for a strategy.

Field.Name: ISIN
Field.Description: ISIN Code. Not applicable for a strategy.

Field.Name: TradeAtReference
Field.Description: A flag to indicate that the instrument is a TaS or TaR type.

Field.Name: PriceCode
Field.Description: The price code that specifies the type of TaS or TaR instrument. Not applicable for non Trade at Reference tradable instruments.

Field.Name: PromptDateLabel
Field.Description: Prompt Date Label. Not applicable for a strategy.

Field.Name: PromptType
Field.Description: Identifies whether the prompt is a single or a rolling prompt. Not applicable for a strategy.

Field.Name: OptionStrikeRelativePosition
Field.Description: ATM Strike is zero, ITM relative positions are positive and OTM positions are negative. Null if Contract Type is Future or Instrument Type is Strategy.

Field.Name: StrategyTypeCode
Field.Description: Strategy Type. Null for an outright.

Field.Name: RemainingRecords
Field.Description: Number of remaining records to be published. When the value of RemainingRecords equals RecordCount this is the last message.

Field.Name: RecordCount
Field.Description: The number of records in this message.

Field.Name: StrategyLegCount
Field.Description: Number of strategy legs.

Field.Name: Definition Legs
Field.Description: The strategy legs carried by this message, counted by RecordCount.

Message.Name: Order Statistics - Intraday Message
Message.Description: Generated at the end of each Ring trading session for instruments that have traded. Two messages are published, one for each high price and low price. If no price has been received the field is set to null.

Field.Name: TimeOfEvent
Field.Description: The time at which the transaction occurred.

Field.Name: TradableInstrumentID
Field.Description: Tradable Instrument ID.

Field.Name: TradingVenue
Field.Description: Trading venue.

Field.Name: RingSession
Field.Description: This identifies the ring trading session.

Field.Name: OrderHigh
Field.Description: Highest 3M bid price for the current Ring session, in implicit six decimal place format.

Field.Name: OrderLow
Field.Description: Lowest 3M ask price for the current Ring session, in implicit six decimal place format.
